title: Blindfold Chess Test
transcript: Would you be able to play chess blindfolded? Let's put it to the test. I am going to play some moves and then I'm going to ask you to find checkmate. Level one. E4. F6. D4. G5. Can you find checkmate for white in one move? If you said queen H5 checkmate, you are correct. Level two. E4. E5. Bishop C4. Knight C6, Queen H5, G6, Queen F3, and Knight G to E7. Can you find checkmate for white in this position? If you said Queen takes F7, checkmate, you are correct. Level three. This time, we're going to play for the black pieces. E4. E5. Knight F3. Knight C6. Bishop C4. Knight D4. Knight takes E5. Queen G5. Knight takes F7. Queen takes G2. Rook F1. Queen takes C4. Check. Bishop E2. Can you now find the checkmate for black in one move? How many levels were you able to beat?
